paper.title: MobileSteward: Integrating Multiple App-Oriented Agents with Self-Evolution to Automate Cross-App Instructions
paper.central_claim: MobileSteward integrates app-oriented StaffAgents with a central StewardAgent for information-flow-aware dynamic recruitment, assigned execution and adjusted evaluation, using memory-based self-evolution to continuously improve cross-app instruction automation.

gap.author_gap: Procedure-oriented mobile agents struggle with cross-app diversity, dependency ordering, error propagation and information handoff; static systems do not accumulate app expertise.
gap.checked_gap: Paper concretely implements app-oriented DAG dispatch and result propagation. Generic success-filtered persistent memory already in AWM; AppAgent and MobileAgentv2 ancestry author-described, direct originals unavailable.

lineage.relationship: Hash-bound cached AWM §2.3: evaluator-selected successful workflows added into memory for later streamed queries.
Primary §3.3 explicitly builds StaffAgent on AppAgent.

reason: Complete calibration initial review; scoped online evidence, no independent reproduction.
rationale: Explicit dependency-aware app delegation is coherent and partly ablated. Memory persistence is real, but its5pp same-app streaming benefit is not proof of sustained self-improvement; test memory updates and unvalidated success writes limit retention claims. Independent outcome protocols and global budget parity remain underreported.
